title: Comet-background-subtraction pipeline parameters
description: Headless background subtraction of Lunaphore COMET OME-TIFFs (Horizon auto mode) for QuPath

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Provide exactly one of 'input' (samplesheet) or 'input_dir' (directory glob).

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns: sample_id,image_path[,remove]. 'remove' is an optional ';' or '|' separated list of marker names to drop from that image.

input_dir.description: Directory containing raw COMET images (*.tif / *.tiff / *.ome.tif). One job per file; sample_id is the filename stem. Convenience alternative to --input.

outdir.description: Output directory for background-subtracted OME-TIFFs, markers CSVs and pipeline_info.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used by Nextflow publishDir to stage output files.

marker_detection_options.title: Marker detection options
marker_detection_options.description: Controls how comet_markers.py derives the backsub markers CSV from COMET OME-XML.

registration_filter.description: FluorescenceChannel/band used for registration. Channels in this band are references and are never background-subtracted.

keep_background.description: Keep autofluorescence / negative-control channels in the output. By default they are flagged remove=TRUE and dropped after subtraction.

remove_extra_dapi.description: Flag every registration (DAPI) channel except the first with remove=TRUE.

use_nearest_background.description: Use the nearest preceding same-band background of any kind (autofluorescence OR negative-control), matching the canonical backsub algorithm. Default replicates Horizon 'auto' mode: always the same-band autofluorescence (_AF) reference.

save_ram.description: Pass -sr to backsub to reduce RAM usage (~50%). Recommended for large COMET slides.

compression.description: Output OME-TIFF compression. 'zlib'/'deflate' (DEFLATE) compresses 16-bit microscopy data better than 'lzw'; all are lossless and read by QuPath.

tile_size.description: Pyramid tile size in pixels (must be a multiple of 16).

downscale_factor.description: Pyramid downscale factor. Only used when the input image is not already pyramidal.

pixel_size.description: Pixel size in microns/pixel. Taken from image metadata if not provided.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.
